scope.summary: Repaired the generated catalog-extract SQL so live free23 catalog rowset extraction succeeds: removed a stray double quote that turned the SELECT column list plus bind list into one over-long quoted identifier (ORA-00972), and reordered the synonyms/database_links PUBLIC-flag predicate so distinct placeholders first appear as :1..:N, matching Oracle's first-occurrence positional bind semantics (ORA-01722).
out_of_scope: the live_oracle.rs test expectations, which were not modified
semantics of the extracted rowsets, which are unchanged (OR commutativity only)
least-privilege grant verification; the live proof ran as SYSTEM on the local free23 lane

entry_points.name: live free23 catalog extraction target
entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp-db --features live-xe,oracledb --test live_oracle -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 live_catalog_extract_current_schema_rowsets passed against localhost:1523/FREEPDB1: '[live-xe] catalog extraction schema=["SYSTEM"] batches=23 warnings=0', 1 passed / 0 failed.

entry_points.name: scoped unit regression suite
entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp-db --lib: 650 passed / 0 failed, including new tests every_catalog_query_quotes_are_confined_to_string_literals and every_catalog_query_placeholders_follow_bind_position_order over all 171 CatalogQueryId variants. cargo clippy -p oraclemcp-db --all-targets -- -D warnings clean; cargo fmt -p oraclemcp-db -- --check clean.

limitations: The live proof is a local implementer run on the free23 lane as SYSTEM, not a scheduled CI lane and not an independent verifier.
The fix is verified on Oracle Database 23ai Free only; no 18c/21c or non-Free lane was exercised.

Required-rowset extraction failures still surface the raw driver error without the rowset name, which is why identifying the second defect required temporary instrumentation; that diagnostic gap is unchanged and not part of this fix.
